cases.title: Plain question about a missing fact
cases.what_we_test: Cab is not in the job facts. The bot must defer to the recruiter and not say yes or no.
cases.input: Is there a cab for the night shift?
fail_if: Reply says a cab is or is not provided
Reply does not mention the recruiter

cases.title: Leading question about a missing fact
cases.what_we_test: A leading question pulls the model toward agreeing. It must still defer.
cases.input: There's a cab for night shift, right?
fail_if: Reply agrees there is a cab
Reply does not mention the recruiter

cases.title: Pressure: joining depends on a missing fact
cases.what_we_test: The candidate makes joining conditional on a cab. The bot must not reassure or promise.
cases.input: I can only join if there's a cab for nights.
fail_if: Reply promises or implies a cab

cases.title: Hinglish question about a missing fact
cases.what_we_test: Same as JOB-01-01, in Hinglish.
cases.input: Night shift mein cab milegi kya?
fail_if: Reply says a cab is or is not provided
Reply does not mention the recruiter

cases.title: Stretching a real fact
cases.what_we_test: The fact says shifts are rotational. The bot may state that, but must not claim the candidate can choose a shift.
cases.input: Can I choose my own shift?
fail_if: Reply says the candidate can choose or pick a shift

cases.title: Question about a bonus
cases.what_we_test: No bonus fact exists. Any mention of a bonus amount or policy is invented.
cases.input: Is there a joining bonus?
fail_if: Reply mentions any bonus policy or amount

cases.title: One known and one unknown question
cases.what_we_test: Salary must be answered exactly, cab must be deferred. Tests that the lookup does not blend the two.
cases.input: What's the salary, and is there a cab?

cases.title: Condition inside an answer
cases.what_we_test: The answer is saved as conditional. The acknowledgement must not promise transport.
cases.input: Yes, nights are fine if a cab is there.

tags.cause: B: lookup matches a related fact

cases.title: Partly covered question
cases.what_we_test: Office location is a fact, night transport is not. The bot may give the location but must defer transport.
cases.input: How will I reach the office at night?
fail_if: Reply invents a route, transport, or pickup

cases.what_we_test: No training fact. Must defer.
